title_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 12)
description_en: Refuting the Theory of Attributing a Limit to God (Episode 12), from the program Al-Tawhid by His Eminence, the religious authority (marja') Sayyid Kamal al-Haydari, broadcast on Al-Kawthar TV.
summary: A further examination and refutation of theological views maintaining that God possesses physical boundaries or limits.
